name: 33880 · Winter Haven, FL
findings: ZIP 33880 (Winter Haven) has 104 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33880 (Winter Haven) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33880 (Winter Haven) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).
